agent.name: ECM Parameter Identification Agent
agent.welcomeMessage:
Hello! I am the ECM Parameter Identification Assistant. I can help you with battery equivalent circuit model parameter identification and uncertainty analysis.

You can:
- Ask me to analyze ECM parameters for a discharge cycle
- Perform uncertainty assessment (confidence intervals, Bootstrap, sensitivity analysis)
- Run the complete analysis pipeline

What would you like to do?
